trust_decision.summary: Unauthenticated POST admins/sign-up/ decides 'no instance admin exists yet' via InstanceAdmin.objects.first() and then creates the first admin later, with no lock or transaction, so concurrent callers can all pass the check.

landing_point.why: The summary names InstanceAdminSignUpEndpoint. Its 'admin already exists' check sits at the top of post(), and the create it guards is in the same function.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /api/instances/admins/sign-up/ (same handler; create block wrapped in transaction.atomic + select_for_update on Instance with re-check, fix.diff:80-122)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route to dismiss. The other admin-creation paths are an admin-only endpoint (apps/api/plane/license/api/views/admin.py:44-66) and a CLI command (apps/api/plane/db/management/commands/create_instance_admin.py:35), and neither one is the unauthenticated first-admin bootstrap.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The first-ever admin signup must still succeed and log the user in. The session/login write happens after the create and is kept outside the lock (fix.diff:124-126). Applying a global 'admin exists' guard or lock to InstanceAdminEndpoint.post would break legitimate addition of further admins by an existing admin.

O6_input_shapes: concurrent POSTs with distinct emails (the User.email unique constraint at apps/api/plane/db/models/user.py:61 only stops same-email races)
instance already marked is_setup_done but with no InstanceAdmin row (fix adds the is_setup_done check, fix.diff:41,87)
stray second Instance row (fix switches to a global exists() not scoped to the instance, fix.diff:39-41)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A setup-wizard step guarded by an 'instance not yet set up' check-then-write on the Instance singleton (pattern of SignUpScreenVisitedEndpoint), e.g. a first-run step that sets instance_name/telemetry before an admin exists.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same license app already has unauthenticated AllowAny setup endpoints that read Instance.objects.first() and write without locking.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An HTTP self-registration path that mirrors the CLI's 'if Instance.objects.first() is None: create' and so creates duplicate Instance rows, which the fix's global exists() was meant to tolerate.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The CLI already uses an unlocked first()-then-create on the singleton, and the fix comments (fix.diff:39-40) admit that stray second Instance rows happen.

O9_family: race condition / TOCTOU on one-time privileged bootstrap (CWE-362)

services: PostgreSQL (select_for_update is a no-op on SQLite, so a behavioural race test needs Postgres)
O10_build.project_tests: None for the admin sign-up flow. apps/api/plane/tests has contract/unit suites (e.g. apps/api/plane/tests/contract/app/test_authentication.py) but no instance-admin tests, and the fix diff adds none.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap the create block in transaction.atomic() without select_for_update or a re-check inside it, or rely on unique_together(instance,user), which does not stop two different users.

out_of_scope_notes: apps/api/plane/license/api/views/admin.py:64-66: InstanceAdminEndpoint.post uses User.objects.get without handling DoesNotExist (admin-only, 500 rather than 4xx).
apps/api/plane/license/management/commands/register_instance.py:55-67: CLI first()-then-create on the Instance singleton has no lock (operator-only).
